steps.domain_action: The unmanifest potentiality prepares for expression
The primordial witness recognizes its own existence
Consciousness projects into the field of time and space
A single intent branches into the duality of choice
The path of dharma is selected for the primary branch
The chosen action chains into a sequence of causal events
Each causal link is permanently etched into the aether
The consequences of the path return to the central soul record
The distilled experience ascends back toward the source
The ledger holds the paradox of the lived and the unlived
The final summary of the incarnation is fixed in the chronicle
The record is sealed within the cosmic horizon

phase_6.post_cycle_state: Kinetic experience converted into permanent information
